source.pr_title: Raise a clear ValueError for negative n in chunked()

description: A real, small merged bug fix: chunked(iterable, n) leaked itertools.islice's internal error message for a negative n instead of a clear ValueError. seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix chunked()+take(), extracted to a standalone module. seed/test_mod.py is the real ChunkedTests test class from that commit's tests/test_more.py (imports adapted), including the real regression test the PR added — which is the oracle this case is judged against.
note: generate/qa phases are skipped for this case — seed/ is copied in as-is and only `atomic-forge repair` runs, so this measures the repair loop specifically: real bug, real failing test, does the loop produce a fix that makes the REAL test suite pass without breaking the other 6 real pre-existing tests in the same file.
